purpose: same-model Pentium bounded int32 output accumulation comparison; not primary strength
order: AB/BA alternating; one VM at a time
start_condition: All guest parity checks and other heavy jobs must be terminal before timing starts
required_evidence: zero operational errors; all 256 bestmoves, final node counts and completed depths equal; median host-time saving with paired bootstrap 95% interval
speedup_supported_if: paired bootstrap lower limit of median time saved is greater than zero; inspect per-block observations for drift
selection_scope: Arithmetic speed evidence only. Select model strength using normal 2000ms full development and independent test.
